The '''Goshyn system''' was located in the [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Goshyn Detention Center]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Gamer3" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before<ref name="Gamer4">{{GamerCite|4|Ships of the Smuggler's Alliance}}</ref> [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|3|The Smugglers Alliance}} establishes that [[Billey]] had been released from the [[Goshyn Detention Center]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Billey]] was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] at the Goshyn Detention Center.<ref name="Gamer3" /> Following his release, Billey continued his smuggling operations, using a [[Space Master medium transport|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] named the ''[[Goshyn Queen]]''.<ref name="Gamer4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Goshyn [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
